name: Bay Area Crisis Nursery - Food Pantry & Diaper Bank
description: Free food and diapers for families in need
fullDescription: Bay Area Crisis Nursery operates a food pantry and diaper bank providing free non-perishable and fresh food and diapers to families with young children. The Diaper Bank is open to the whole community.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free non-perishable and fresh food
- Free diapers for babies and toddlers
- Order by phone for pickup
- Food pantry open daily for pickups
- Food provided in partnership with the Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano
- No-cost support for families in need
howToGetIt:
1. Call the Nursery at 925-685-8052
2. Ask to order a food and/or diaper pickup
3. Provide family information
4. Arrange a pickup time
5. Pick up at the Concord location
6. Visit the free BACN Boutique while you're there
keywords: BACN, food pantry, diaper bank, free diapers, free food, Concord, baby supplies, Crisis Nursery
